```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{2*pi}
    \def\Ly{4}
    \def\h{0.75*\Ly}

    \draw[dashed,samples=10,variable=\x,domain=0:{2/0.75}]
        plot(\x,{\h*\x/2});
    \draw[mydarkblue,samples=100,variable=\x,domain=-\Lx/2:\Lx/2]
        plot(\x,{\h*(abs(sin(deg(\x/2))))});
    \draw (0.01*\Lx,\h) -- (-0.01*\Lx,\h) node[left] at (0,\h) {$\sqrt{4k/m}$};

    \draw[->] (-\Lx/2,0) -- (\Lx/2,0) node[right] {$\eta$};
    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,\Ly) node[right] {$\omega(\eta)$};
    \node[mydarkblue] at (0.3*\Lx,0.2*\Ly) {$\sqrt{ \frac{4k}{m}}\abs{\sin\eta/2}$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
